# @trysac/changelog-conventional

> TypeScript library for Node.js 20+ that parses Conventional Commits 1.0.0 messages, computes the next SemVer 2.0.0 version, renders Keep a Changelog sections and reads git through an injectable port. Published as ES modules with type declarations. Zero runtime dependencies. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation, usage example and API summary
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): test files, coverage and commands
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, timeline and effort metrics
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
